steps.subject: sky
steps.action: crisscross blue at the very top
steps.load: little phthalo blue on the brush
steps.rule: clear makes the surface slick so paint blends
steps.new: lighter lower down as paint is used up

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: darken the top corners

steps.motion: blend down until no edge shows
steps.rule: dark corners pull the eye toward the center

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: thin blue wash over the gesso shapes

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: add a brighter sparkle

steps.subject: grass

steps.rule: pulls up underlying color to soften more

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: darken grass with black and yellow
steps.motion: push and dab a ridge of paint

steps.subject: path
steps.action: graze the path top with brown and white

steps.motion: touch along the edge and pull around

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: touch dark paint back into the highlights
steps.motion: touch and play back and forth

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: lighter leaves with green and yellows

steps.rule: red dulls green because they are opposites

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: leaves with the other corner of the brush

steps.rule: leaving some dark showing gives needed shadows

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: brighten the front tree edge with thinner
